data.content: Now I'll compile the comprehensive report from all the exploration I've done. Here's the detailed analysis: ## **IconPicker Architecture & Glyph Rendering Report** ### **1. Core Components & Lazy Loading Strategy** **Main Component:** [IconPicker.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue#L1-L150) The picker uses **four async-loaded manifests** loaded on mount: - [cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-instui.json) — InstUI icons (mixed Lucide + custom sources) - [cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-lucide-lab.json) — Lucide Lab set - [cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-icon-manifest-simple.json) — Simple Icons brand slugs (~4.7 MB raw, ~1.8 MB gzip per script) - [cdn-plugin-manifest.json](docs/.vitepress/theme/generated/cdn-plugin-manifest.json) — Custom components, plugins, logos **Manifest Load Pattern:** Each loads separately with error handling, showing "Loading icon list…" state. Deep-linking (URL hash) allows state restoration once manifests arrive. --- ### **2. Glyph Rendering CSS Mechanism** The icon display uses a **three-layer CSS system**: #### **Layer 1: Icon Tokens** — [icons.css](formats/components/dist/icons.css) Contains 1800+ `--instui-icon-` custom properties, each holding an inline SVG data-URI: ```css :root { --instui-icon-check: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); --instui-icon-chevron-down: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...%3E'); /* ... 1800+ more ... */ } ``` #### **Layer 2: Glyph Classifiers** — [icon-glyphs.ts](formats/components/src/utilities/icon-glyphs/index.ts#L42-L60) Generated by `iconGlyphsCss()`, creates one class per icon: ```css .-icon-check { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-check); } .-icon-chevron-down { --pantoken-glyph: var(--instui-icon-chevron-down); } /* The -render-icon-* deprecated aliases also exist when built with deprecatedAliases: true */ ``` #### **Layer 3: Painter Utility** — [icon.css](formats/components/src/utilities/icon/icon.css#L15-L23) The shared `::before` pseudo-element that renders all glyphs: ```css [class*="-icon-"]::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; inline-size: 1em; block-size: 1em; vertical-align: -0.125em; background: currentColor; -webkit-mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; mask: var(--pantoken-glyph) center / contain no-repeat; } ``` **Key technique:** The `mask` property (with `-webkit` prefix for older browsers) uses the SVG data-URI as a mask image. The `background: currentColor` fills it in the element's inherited color, so glyphs inherit text color and scale with font-size. **Concrete Example —** A rendered icon: ```html ``` Results in: 1. `--pantoken-glyph` resolves to `var(--instui-icon-search)` 2. Which is `url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,%3Csvg...search-glyph...%3E')` 3. The `::before` masks that SVG and paints it in `currentColor` --- ### **3. Per-Icon CSS Delivery** — [build-icon-entries.ts](formats/components/scripts/build-icon-entries.ts) For CDN optimization, each icon also ships as a **standalone ~1-line file**: ``` formats/components/generated/icons/.css ``` Example: [arrow-left.css](formats/components/dist/icons/arrow-left.css) would contain: ```css :root{--instui-icon-arrow-left:url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,...')}.-icon-arrow-left{--pantoken-glyph:var(--instui-icon-arrow-left)} ``` This pattern allows: - **Selective loading:** Only load icons you use (via CDN URL builder) - **Combined URLs:** Multiple icons per request via jsDelivr combine syntax - **Fallback to full sheet:** Or load all with `icons.css` (master bundle) --- ### **4. Lazy Rendering & Performance** **Lazy Loading Techniques Used:** 1. **Async Manifest Loading:** Three icon sources load independently with `shallowRef` (Vue 3), avoiding unnecessary re-renders until data arrives 2. **Image Lazy Loading (Simple Icons only):** - [PickerToggleGroupItem.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/PickerToggleGroupItem.vue#L61) uses `loading="lazy"` on `` tags: ```html ``` - Logo images fetched from jsDelivr CDN; native browser lazy-loading defers off-screen images 3. **Scrollable Sections:** - [Icon picker sections](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/IconPicker.vue#L645): ```css .icon-picker__sections { max-height: 28rem; overflow-y: auto; } ``` - Limits vertical scroll; grid layout with `repeat(auto-fill, minmax(9rem, 1fr))` 4. **Search Filtering:** Computed property filters icons synchronously (no pagination needed; filtering is fast enough for 1800+ items) 5. **No Virtual Scrolling:** Uses native CSS scrolling + Vue reactivity; performance is adequate because: - Icons are `::before` pseudo-elements (not real DOM nodes per icon) - Each grid item is a checkbox + span, very lightweight - Manifest loading is the bottleneck, not rendering **What's NOT used:** No `content-visibility`, no `IntersectionObserver`, no virtual list library — the approach prioritizes simplicity over extreme scale. --- ### **6. CSS Bundle Strategy** | File | Purpose | Approx Size | Load Pattern | |------|---------|------------|--------------| | **icons.css** | Master icon sheet (all ~1800+ `--instui-icon-*` vars + all `.-icon-*` classes) | ~500+ KB (minified) | Docs theme loads globally; CDN usage loads selectively per icon or by category | | **icons/{name}.css** | Per-icon file (1 var + 1 class) | ~50–100 bytes each | CDN builder combines multiple into single request | | **component-icons.css** | Just the painter utility (`.instui-icon` sizing + `[class*="-icon-"]::before`) | ~1 KB | Docs always loads; used by all icon consumers | **Bundle Optimization Pattern:** - User selects icons in picker → generates CDN URLs - Links generated as `` tags or `@import` statements - jsDelivr combines multiple files: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/combine/npm/@pantoken/components/dist/icons/arrow-left.css,npm/@pantoken/components/dist/icons/check.css` - Or users load full `icons.css` and single `.-icon-*` classes --- ### **7. Key Performance Insights for TinyMCE Dialog** **What makes this approach efficient:** 1. **Mask-image rendering** — No DOM bloat; `::before` pseudo is lightweight and inherits color/size automatically 2. **Scoped scrolling** — Single overflow container for all 1800+ items;
